description: This PHP source file defines the 'Country' class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace. The class contains methods to add, edit, and delete country data, primarily by scheduling tasks related to country data management. It interacts with the model 'setting/task' to enqueue tasks for country list, info, and delete operations, with some commented-out code indicating potential admin-specific task handling.
